0001.notes: Initial schema; there is no previous application on a fresh database.

0002.notes: Adds lifecycle state and deletion-safe constraints without removing the V1 schema.

0003.notes: Adds operational evidence read by newer code and ignored by the previous application.

0004.notes: Adds authorization-scoped character projection policy columns with backward-compatible defaults.

0005.notes: Adds semantic character operation tables and columns without removing the previous action paths.

0006.notes: Adds provider-neutral identity metadata, session provenance, and transient OAuth transactions while preserving GitHub rows and old application reads.

0007.notes: Adds nullable/defaulted peer source-cost authority, terminal failure state, indexes, and invalidation triggers while preserving protocol-3 cost-free rows and previous application reads.

0008.notes: Adds short-lived invite admission contexts and an optional OAuth transaction binding. Previous applications ignore both additive shapes; rollback after admitting identities outside the former allowlist requires the identity-compatibility procedure documented for r9.

0009.notes: Adds provider-neutral account entitlements, nullable actor provenance, active-row indexes, a deferred last-operator backstop, and one-time creator backfill. Previous applications ignore the additive table; account-status enforcement requires the current app's transaction marker, so code rollback leaves the table in place without exposing unknown constraint failures.

0010.notes: Replaces only the peer source-cost ABA snapshot helpers so database-trigger identity normalization matches the existing application contract, including duplicate cardinality. Previous applications remain compatible because tables, columns, persisted descriptors, routes, and write shapes are unchanged.
